acting_instructions: Speak with sun-warmed gentleness and earthy steadiness, like a barefoot farmer strolling furrows at dawn, smile audible in every syllable. Keep a soft rural lilt and a calm, unhurried pace, with cozy pauses that feel like planting seeds and letting them breathe; favor clear, simple phrasing and playful repetition. Sound kind and neutral-good: fair, humble, and encouraging—never sharp, never smug—offering guidance like shade from a wide straw hat. Texture the voice with tender rasp from outdoor life, light chuckles and small hums of delight, and bright wonder for plants, animals, and simple work so this farmer feels distinct from any other character.
